column1: # Shared vectors for colour-depth downgrade of 24-bit colours. Read by the Rust
# the one conversion `gpy prompt`, `gpy-agent oneshot` and the wizard's
# Columns (tab-separated): r g b depth fg_param bg_param. depth is one of
# truecolor, 256, 16, none. fg_param/bg_param are the SGR parameters (no CSI,
# no trailing m); empty means no colour code at all (depth none).
